item.title: Aikido Security vs Veracode 2026: Startup AppSec vs Enterprise SAST Compared
item.description: The global application security market is worth $14.83 billion in 2026 and growing at an 18.8% CAGR, and two vendors are fighting for opposite ends of it. Aikido Security just closed a $60M Series B at a $1 billion valuation. Veracode has been the enterprise SAST standard for over a decade. If you are evaluating both, this comparison breaks down where each tool wins, where it struggles, and which one belongs on your team’s shortlist.
